title: A spectral primitive with finite distributional second derivative has an integrable holonomy budget

bv_primitive.hypothesis: The atom-free divided densities G_+,G_- are supported away from zero; their zero extensions lie in W^{1,1}(R) and have finite signed distributional second-derivative measures.
bv_primitive.equivalent_piecewise_class: On finitely many compact intervals, zero endpoint trace plus L1 first derivative and BV first derivative is sufficient; jumps of the first derivative are allowed and enter the measure norm.
bv_primitive.decay: With B_0=||G_+||_1+||G_-||_1 and B_BV=|D^2G_+|(R)+|D^2G_-|(R), the Fourier identity gives |tilde a(t)|<=min(B_0,t^(-2)B_BV).
bv_primitive.strict_extension: This includes K1608's zero-extended W^{2,1} class and also piecewise-smooth primitives with derivative jumps.
bv_primitive.scope_guard: Density endpoint jumps are not allowed, electric-field L1 is not proved, and the spectral representation is not derived from a nonlinear source-owned flow.
